dedupe_keys.name: esa worldcereal 2021 global temporary crop crop type and active irrigation maps at 10 m

description: The ESA WorldCereal project released the first seasonally updated global maps of temporary crops, crop types and irrigation at 10 m resolution, currently for 2021, with more products planned by the end of 2026. Next to the annual temporary crop extent, season-specific products cover maize, winter cereals, spring cereals, active cropland and active irrigation, each generated at the end of a growing season and masked by the annual crop extent. The page recommends an interactive viewer for maps and statistics, a web interface for downloading an area of interest, the full collection on Zenodo (version v100 of May 2023, CC BY 4.0) and the Earth Engine data catalogue. Coverage is global croplands. Access is free as raster downloads, a viewer and Earth Engine. Caveats: each global map is a mosaic of regional maps with their own season definitions by agro-ecological zone, so neighbouring zones cannot be compared directly, and only 2021 is released. Simulation uses: mapping actively irrigated land for irrigation demand and drought exposure. Related record: LGRIP30 (data-usgs-lgrip30-global-rainfed-irrigated-cropland-30m).
